header: Full-width rows with room for a paragraph
lead: Each row has an icon and a full paragraph, with a line between rows. Use it when a grid cell is too small for the text.

items.title: A paragraph per row, not a caption
items.text: Each row spans the full width, so it can hold a claim, the reason and the result. That is the difference from the feature grid.

items.title: A line instead of a gap
items.text: A thin line separates the rows, so a long list reads as one group. The line matches every other divided list on the page.

items.title: Compact when the list gets long
items.text: The compact option reduces the space between rows but keeps the font sizes. A list of ten rows then takes less space on the page.
